name: starmemory
description: Hybrid recall for Claude Code and Codex conversations: Tantivy BM25 + usearch HNSW over LMDB, fused by reciprocal rank. Both harnesses share one memory.

interface.shortDescription: One shared memory for Claude Code and Codex conversations
interface.longDescription: StarMemory indexes Claude Code and Codex transcripts into one local LMDB store with BM25 and HNSW retrieval, so a conversation from either harness is searchable from both.
